nodes.label: ADDED_COLUMNS auto-migration (src/lib/db.ts)
nodes.rationale: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS does not alter existing tables, so new columns (e.g. min_age, audience) must be listed in ADDED_COLUMNS for older databases to upgrade.

nodes.label: Age filter (Allir / 0-14 / Fjölskyldan / 15-19 / 20+)
nodes.rationale: Scraper stores items.min_age and items.audience (rules in scraper/lib/ages.ts); fitsAgeGroup in src/lib/feed-types.ts applies the filter. Hidden-item count is shown so the effect of a saved filter is visible.

nodes.label: Environment config (.env.example / .env.local)
nodes.rationale: Secrets go in git-ignored .env.local; never put secrets in NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables since they can reach the browser.

nodes.label: Icelandic formatting without Intl (src/lib/format.ts)
nodes.rationale: Avoids Intl so server and browser render identical text (no hydration mismatch).

nodes.label: Shared HTTP helper honoring robots.txt (scraper/lib/http.ts)
nodes.rationale: Respects robots.txt, identifies with SCRAPER_USER_AGENT and waits SCRAPER_DELAY_MS between requests to the same site.

nodes.label: Incremental scraping via items.version
nodes.rationale: Slow sources (sundlaugar.is, ofurkaup.is) store page change info to avoid unnecessary re-reads; first run is slow, later runs faster.

nodes.label: isMusic music classification rule
nodes.rationale: Uses organizer categories (Tónleikar, Tónlist, Rokk og popp, Klassík, Jazz og blús, Kór, Ópera) or titles containing 'tónleikar'; musicals stay in theatre, children's events count only if concerts.

nodes.label: localStorage saving (Vista / Á planið / age group)
nodes.norm_label: localstorage saving (vista / a planið / age group)
nodes.rationale: Saved items and selected age group live in browser localStorage so no user account is required in the current version.

nodes.label: Movie title matching (items.match_key, src/lib/match.ts)
nodes.rationale: Merges the same film from several sources into one card with a normalized title.

nodes.label: Opening hours to time slots (scraper/lib/schedule.ts, v_open_soon)
nodes.norm_label: opening hours to time slots (scraper/lib/schedule.ts, v_open_soon)

nodes.label: Idempotent upsert store (scraper/lib/store.ts)
nodes.rationale: Inserts new rows and updates existing ones so repeated runs do not create duplicates.

nodes.label: v_current_items view
nodes.rationale: Shows only items seen in the source's last successful scrape so vanished items disappear; failed scrapes hide nothing.
